title: ci(release): retire the rc channel — delete cut-rc.yml, remove the retired rc dist-tag
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9WrbfurU16VFMgPKTWCi1GD)_
Fixes #26196
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:删掉 Cut RC 工作流(`cut-rc.yml`),发布通道只剩 `latest`(正式版)和 `next`(预发布);发布后整理 npm 标签的脚本对 `rc` 改为删除而不是挪动;文档和脚本注释里指向 cut-rc 的说法全部改掉。
- **为什么改**:维护者裁定「现在只有 latest 和 next」。cut-rc 只能发 `rc`,留着会让人和 AI 以为 `rc` 通道还活着;npm 上 68 个包至今还挂着 `rc: 17.0.0-rc.6`。
- **风险与回滚**:正式发布流程(`release.yml`)只改了注释，行为不变;变化在下一次正式版发布后的标签整理步骤：它会删掉 `rc` 标签(该步骤本来就是非阻塞的)。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:① `scripts/release-dist-tags.mjs` 的 `RETIRED_TAGS` 与 `planTags` 删除分支;② `docs/releases-maintenance.md` 新的「Release channels」节;③ `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` 改写的 wiring 断言(原来要求 cut-rc.yml 存在)。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/release-dist-tags.mjs`(只读计划，不写 npm),预期末行 `73 tag(s) would move, 68 retired tag(s) would be removed … 0 failure(s)`。
- **需要你做的**:这是受管面(`.github/workflows/**`)改动，需要 GOVERNED_APPROVERS(os-zhuang、hotlong)批准后落地;PR 保持 draft,席位不转 ready、不开自动合并。

## What changes

1. **`.github/workflows/cut-rc.yml` is deleted.** It could only cut `X.Y.Z-rc.N` and refused to run unless `.changeset/pre.json` said `tag: rc`.
2. **Channel rule, stated once** in `docs/releases-maintenance.md` under a new `### Release channels`: `latest` = stable, `next` = pre-release (`release.yml` in pre mode, `.changeset/pre.json` tag `next`, published by `changeset publish` under that tag), no `rc`. The two-route table and the whole "Cutting an rc — the snapshot flow" section (bypass-list prerequisite, stale #6208 note, runtime-image note) are removed; the ADR-0125 environment-gate paragraph is kept and reworded for the one lane. Two other lines that named `cut-rc.yml` (Console build, `fetch-depth: 0`) and one "snapshot flow above" back-reference are reworded.
3. **`scripts/release-dist-tags.mjs`** gains `RETIRED_TAGS = ['rc']` (exported, frozen). `planTags` now returns `{ moves, removes, kept }`: a retired tag is removed whatever it points at (a stale, an ahead, a stable or a non-semver value), checked before any version test; every other tag keeps today's rule, so `next` still moves. `sweep`/`main` take a `remove` writer (`npmDistTagRm` = `npm dist-tag rm NAME TAG`); plan mode prints `plan   NAME rc: VERSION → removed (retired channel)` and the summary counts removals separately. A pre-release `RELEASE_VERSION` still does nothing (the header says a retired tag goes at the next stable publish). The `release.yml` step name and wiring are unchanged.
4. **`scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`**: the wiring battery asserted that `cut-rc.yml` exists and calls this script twice with no `--event`. Those 4 assertions are replaced by 4 over **every** workflow: the walk lists workflow files; control: it finds the real scan in `pr-automation.yml`; every call site is in `pr-automation.yml`; every workflow that runs the script has a `pull_request` trigger. So a new non-PR caller cannot silently land in the `no-pull-request` stand-down lane. The `no-pull-request` comment, verdict-table line and its runtime message now name a local run as the only caller (the message is not pinned by any test: `git grep` of the old and new text).
5. **Comment-only rewording** (no behaviour), so `git grep cut-rc` stops pointing at a deleted lane: `lint.yml` (the `jq` note), `release.yml` (3 comments: the allowlist twin sentence, the one-list principle, the five-filter note), and in `scripts/`: `check-docs-image-tag.mjs`, `check-self-test-wired.mjs` (header + one control comment), `check-skill-compatibility-version.mjs`, `docs-audit/README.md`, `pm/clause2-line.mjs`, `pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`, `pm/release-rehearsal-clone.mjs`, `release-spec-changes.sh`, `sync-release-index-currency.mjs` (4 comments + one self-test case title), `sync-template-versions.mjs`. These 11 files were added to the claim's file surface by the seat before editing.
6. **`scripts/release-verify-npm.mjs`, comment only** (from the seat's check of #26376, which set `release.yml`'s publish job to `timeout-minutes: 120`): the header said the publish job "declares no `timeout-minutes`, so GitHub's 360-minute job default bounds this step"; it now names the 120-minute bound and that raising the 35-minute settle budget means re-checking that sum. Applied after merging `origin/main` (756220c4, which carries #26376 as fa5d72e1) as the seat's prepared commit; `node scripts/release-verify-npm.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, `131 cases pass across 14 batteries`.

## Why

The maintainer, in the triage seat thread: 「现在只有 latest 和 next」, then 「同意」 to retiring the rc lane. A lane that can only cut a channel that no longer exists tells every reader, human or AI, that `rc` is live; the registry still serves `rc: 17.0.0-rc.6`, and the dist-tag sweep after each stable publish would keep moving it forward instead of letting it go.

## Tests

- `node scripts/release-dist-tags.mjs --self-test` → exit 0: `OK release-dist-tags self-test: 54 cases pass across 7 batteries`. New battery 7 "Retired channels: removed, never moved, and only those" (9 cases, floor 9; roster floor 6 → 7): the list is exactly `rc`; today's registry shape gives `rc` = remove and `next` = move; a retired tag on a stable, an ahead and a non-semver value is removed; `next` is never retired; control: with an empty list `rc` moves again; the plan line names the removal; `--apply` removes `rc` through the remover and never `add`s it. Batteries 1–5 updated: every `sweep`/`main` call that could reach a removal passes a stub remover, so the self-test never spawns a real `npm`; the end-to-end battery's stub `npm` on PATH records `dist-tag add @objectstack/cli@18.1.0 next`, `dist-tag rm @objectstack/cli rc`, `dist-tag rm create-objectstack rc`.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, 456 assertions (wiring battery stays at its 22 floor: 4 removed, 4 added).

## Acceptance notes

- **Card acceptance 1:** `git grep -n 'cut-rc' -- .github scripts docs/releases-maintenance.md` on the head returns one line: `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs:26115`, the recorded title of card #9828 inside a fixture roster. It is history and stays. `docs/releases-maintenance.md` names "the Cut RC lane" once, in the channel section, as the retired lane.
- **Card acceptance 2 (plan, read-only):** `node scripts/release-dist-tags.mjs` against registry.npmjs.org, anonymous GETs only, nothing written: `Planning (read-only; pass --apply to write) the dist-tags of 111 package(s)` → `73 tag(s) would move, 68 retired tag(s) would be removed, 0 kept ahead of latest, 0 package(s) skipped, 0 failure(s).` Every move is `next: 18.0.0-next.5 → 18.1.0`, every removal is `rc: 17.0.0-rc.6 → removed (retired channel)`. The card says 73 packages carry `rc`; measured today it is 68: `@objectstack/connector-imap`, `organizations`, `service-mailbox`, `service-print` and `skills` carry `next` but no `rc`. Not run with `--apply` (AGENTS.md directive 15); #25764's one-time sweep is not touched.
- **Card acceptance 3:** every script under `scripts/` that names `release.yml` or `lint.yml` and has a `--self-test` (49 files) was run with `--self-test` on 088f95b9: 48 exit 0; `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test` hit the loop's 280 s cap (exit 124) and is covered by `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` below, which runs it. On 2b9dd3d0 the derived set re-ran the ones it names, and `release-verify-npm.mjs --self-test` passed after the merge (131 cases).
- Left as written, outside the acceptance grep (comments only): `packages/cli/test/scaffold-exact-objectstack-pin.test.ts:12`, `packages/create-objectstack/src/runtime-image.test.ts:237`, `template-consistency.test.ts:799`, `template-version-stamps.test.ts:11,51,274,338,387`. ADRs and `docs/audits/**` are history and unchanged.
- `scripts/release-spec-changes.sh --generate` had one workflow caller, `cut-rc.yml`; after this PR no workflow calls that mode (`release.yml` uses `--prepare`/`--verify`/`--attach`). Observation only.
- `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` still says "RC window" / "RC exemption" for Changesets pre mode in general; that is pre mode, not the deleted lane, and is unchanged.

## Verification

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the final head 2b9dd3d0 (merge base 756220c4) derived 81 commands (the 79 of the pre-merge head 088f95b9 plus `check-adr-links.mjs` and its `--self-test`). All ran locally with stdin from `/dev/null`, exit captured before any pipe; `check:dts-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` after `turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter='./packages/**'` under the verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`, 546 s). `--ran` reconciliation on 2b9dd3d0: **81 derived, 81 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN** (a derived zero). The same 79 had also all exited 0 on 088f95b9. Every other family is CI's, read from this PR's check-runs.

<details><summary>Gate readings</summary>

- all 81 derived commands on 2b9dd3d0: exit 0, including `pnpm check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `pnpm check:required-contexts`, `pnpm check:template-version-sync`, `pnpm check:release-index-currency-sync`, `node scripts/check-self-test-wired.mjs` (+ `--self-test`), `node scripts/pm/release-rehearsal-clone.mjs --self-test`, `node scripts/release-dist-tags.mjs --self-test`.
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` on 2b9dd3d0: exit 0, captured by its wrapper (fast tier, 501.3 s on this box).
- `node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs` first hit the loop's 300 s cap (exit 124) while the build held the box; re-run alone: exit 0, `18308 files, 0 disagree, 0 unparseable, 232.7s`.
- `check:dts-closure`: 75 built packages swept, 233/233 declaration files present. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: provenance line 112/69/2381/1 over floors 90/58/520/1.

</details>

## Human Minimum

Each item is one rule from
[CONTRIBUTING.md › Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum),
which links the AGENTS.md text that states it.

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (`packages/spec` is not touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (`RETIRED_TAGS`, `npmDistTagRm`, `plannedRemovals`.)
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is CI's run, read from `Lint & Repo Gates` on this PR.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. (`origin/main` 756220c4 merged in.)
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (Nothing publishes; both lines are above.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [ ] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (All English except the 维护者速读 block, which the fleet's dev contract asks for in Chinese.)
- [ ] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. (Not walked item by item; the gate readings above are what was run.)

## Changeset

None: the diff touches workflows, a doc and repo-internal scripts under `scripts/`, which no package publishes. `skip-changeset` is set at creation.
